comments.author: @davidyoungtunes
comments.text: Hey Geoff, I watch most of your videos on both channels, and you do a generally good job of educating people. Truly you put some serious work into these videos and I enjoy them quite a lot. But there is a pattern I see of you consistently mispronouncing place names. Now I know mistakes happen, but a good example in this video is Wasatch Mountains. That’s a pretty jarring mispronunciation that immediately sticks out to me and hurts your credibility to many folks watching. This is an ongoing issue I’ve noticed across many videos on your channels. A quick Google search tells you exactly how to pronounce most of these places including Wasatch. I also want to reiterate what some others on here are saying regarding alfalfa production. With some casual digging you can find a wealth of info on this issue in Utah. The alfalfa farms are sucking the rivers dry and in my opinion it’s a shocking misuse of natural resources in a water-vulnerable state. Especially considering some of the biggest farms are Chinese-owned and ship the hay right back to China. That seems to me a big, immediate issue that should be mentioned above climate change or other long-term factors. In fact, the alfalfa farms are likely a leading cause of climate change in the region as they lead to a dwindling Great Salt Lake which in turn creates harmful smog and dust particulates from all the fertilizer runoff from these farms that is now evaporating as the lake dries up. I’m not sure who is to blame for this but I’d guess there is an administrative/governmental financial conflict of interest at least partly responsible. All in all I am a big fan of the channel and I want to see these videos do well. But sometimes I cringe at the misrepresentation that occurs here
